priceSentimentNotifications.title: Price sentiment email alerts
priceSentimentNotifications.description: Automatically monitor the stocks in your Watchlist and receive a daily summary when their long-term price sentiment enters a state you selected.
priceSentimentNotifications.loadError: Notification settings could not be loaded. Please try again.
priceSentimentNotifications.proRequired: Upgrade to Pro to receive daily price sentiment alerts for your Watchlist.
priceSentimentNotifications.enableDescription: Monitor every stock in your Watchlist. No per-stock setup is needed.
priceSentimentNotifications.enabledDescription: Monitoring every stock in your Watchlist automatically.
priceSentimentNotifications.disabledDescription: Enable to automatically monitor every stock in your Watchlist.
priceSentimentNotifications.conditionsHint: Choose the price sentiment states you want to receive. Extreme Fear and Extreme Greed are selected by default.
priceSentimentNotifications.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one sentiment state before enabling notifications.
priceSentimentNotifications.scheduleValue: Scans start daily at 07:00 Taipei time; email is sent when the scan completes
priceSentimentNotifications.triggerNote: An email is sent when a stock enters a selected state. No daily repeats while it remains there; it can alert again after leaving and re-entering the state.
priceSentimentNotifications.saveError: Could not save notification settings. Please try again.
